scope: Independent read-only Python continuation/HOME commit review and offline temporary-fixture tests. E50 Go abort and attempt02 live gates are design prerequisites, not reviewed implementation or executed acceptance in this record.

validation.scope: Offline temporary fixtures and recording subprocess mocks only. No actual prepare/configure/mount/PG/Docker/service action.

reviewed_boundaries: Invalid phase or attempt is rejected before credentials; abort supports only attempt01 and resolves its separate manifest. All three versioned executable paths must agree on one confined full-40-lowercase-hex directory, hashes and regular single-link private executable inputs.

prepare-continuation rechecks original acceptance/config/binaries and exclusively writes two new manifests. It does not invoke credential, subprocess, Docker or PG and cannot overwrite existing manifests or original binaries. A partial preparation remains visible and blocks repetition.

HOME is set only in the new minimal child environment to the previously validated scope root. No parent environment is mutated, and credentials remain absent from systemd argv/properties and intent logs.

The mapped child checks the exact compiled test entry before invoking its one opt-in test. Exit0 is insufficient without the selected final report; attempt02 cannot use attempt01 SIGTERM acceptance. Abort report must explicitly say cancel_requested and terminal=false.

Launcher admission creates an exclusive output directory and random new systemd unit with a separate RootlessKit state directory. It retains nonzero status and requires confirmed unit termination; it does not stop previous services or erase prior evidence.
Production Cancel intentionally remains cancel_requested with a pending stop command. The proposal accurately preserves this nonterminal fixture-abandonment state and the expired original deadline.
required_go_execution_gates_not_yet_veri: Bind exact original tenant/run/schema/input/config/deadline and failed before_runner descriptor. Recheck both SQL header and snapshot lease0, zero effects/model attempts/steps/allocations/fees/artifact publications, no existing journal/WAL/SHM/owner/workspace and empty artifact root before Cancel.

Maintain quiescence: original unit and workers are absent. Store.Cancel is not a conditional compare-and-swap over every precondition; recheck its allowed changes afterward and refuse continuation if any execution evidence appears. Pending stop command and cancel event/version changes are legitimate; do not falsely require commands=0 afterward.

After original cancellation intent, confirm immutable deadline/input/config unchanged and original lease0/zero execution still hold; keep old schema unserved. cancel_requested is schedulable, so never launch any worker with the original private DSN.

Attempt02 must create a different schema/run and distinct private worker config/evidence, link original and new IDs explicitly, and recheck live original proof plus unchanged never-owned pool. No Product ParentRunID retry is implied for this nonterminal fixture.
L5 must bind the selected SIGTERM02 evidence/private schema. Its logs-01 output remains exclusive; prior log evidence cannot be replaced or reinterpreted.
limits: These 31 tests are offline mocks and temporary files. They do not prove mapped namespace/service behavior, live PostgreSQL guards, Docker execution, cancellation completion, SIGTERM recovery, or log acceptance.
Preparing manifests before actual abort is intentional and produces no success claim. The Go fixture remains authoritative for all live preconditions before trial02.

The binary directory revision and local hashes enforce identity consistency, not source-to-binary provenance by themselves. A separate reviewed clean-revision build attestation is required before real execution.
Existing original before-runner read-only PostgreSQL record was inspected without another database connection; it is historical evidence, not a current live precondition.
